catalysts.headline: Shares extended decline after the Oct 6, 2026 Investor Day

Shares extended their decline after the Oct 6 Investor Day, falling a cumulative 17.2% from Oct 9-16 (including an 8.7% single-session drop on Oct 14), attributed to broader AI-capex valuation concerns despite the raised FY2028 (~$20B) and new FY2031 ($70-90B) revenue targets announced at the event.
NYC Investor Day: raised FY2028 revenue outlook to ~$20B (from ~$18B) and set an FY2031 revenue target of $70B-$90B
catalysts.impact: Stock reportedly +5.81% on the session (intraday pop >11% reported by one source); not independently confirmed against a primary Marvell release
